name: mero-sylence-extension
description: Sylence browser extension — records a call tab, transcribes on the laptop, saves to a Calimero workspace

scripts.build: tsc -b && vite build && vite build -c vite.background.config.ts && vite build -c vite.content.config.ts
scripts.codegen: meroctl app codegen --abi ../logic/res/abi.json --lang ts --name mero-sylence -o src/generated
scripts.e2e:call: SYLENCE_E2E=1 pnpm build && SYLENCE_FAKE_CALL=1 playwright test fake-call; pnpm build
scripts.e2e:call:watch: SYLENCE_E2E=1 pnpm build && SYLENCE_FAKE_CALL=1 SYLENCE_CALL_WATCH=1 SYLENCE_CALL_PLATFORMS=${SYLENCE_CALL_PLATFORMS:-meet} playwright test fake-call --timeout=0; pnpm build
